page.notes: Column 2 bottom "13 Vasa furoris Ichouę, ad disper-" continues at the top of column 3 ("dendū vniuersam terrā 433.a"); joined here. Doubtful readings: "falsugi-" (Ps. 106 "salsuginem"?), "perieos", "incef-", "re-fiduum", "re[?]" at the end of Prov. 25, and the printed form "afimilabitis" read as "asimilabitis". Several verse numbers are at the margin of the column and were copied as printed. The number "2" at the start of the Jeremiah line is a verse number belonging to that line.
